ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (estimated 95% of visible area) with high contrast against a low-intensity black perimeter and localized central spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A vast, contiguous white region covers the majority of the fluke surface; a continuous, thin black band follows the trailing edge and distal tips; a vertical linear series of small dark pixel clusters is centered at the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 10% of the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of variations peaks at approximately 15 pixels at the distal tips and diminishes to 3-5 pixels near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the leading edges, with the trailing edge lobes following a broad arc that tapers toward slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A vertical alignment of approximately 8 small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) located at the central base/peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, irregular, and textured pigmentation patches on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized trauma or persistent epiphytic attachment; small dark pockmarks at the central fluke base.
other_distinctive_markers: Notably high-purity white ventral surface lacking typical large-scale mottling, characterized specifically by the unique central vertical column of dark pigmentation spots.
